title: ProducerRecord
description: One registered ingest producer (PRP-41). Carries every field of the ingest edge's ProducerRegistration (services/api ingest/auth.py) so the registry can be loaded from the admin_config store: the producer authenticates with Authorization: Bearer <producer_id>.<secret> and the edge compares SHA-256(secret) with secret_sha256 in constant time. Only the hash is stored; the secret is returned once, in ProducerSecretIssued. A disabled producer is refused at the edge. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (source_id values are unique) are checked by tests/contracts/validators.py::check_producer_sources_unique.

producer_id.description: Producer identifier, the part of the bearer credential before the dot. Same grammar as ProducerRegistration.producer_id.

sources.description: Sources this producer may publish for, and how each source's data is observed (ProducerRegistration.sources).

secret_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the producer secret. A digest, never the secret.

rotated_at.description: When the current secret was issued (first issue or last rotation). Null for producers imported from a static registry file.

source_id.description: Source identifier the producer publishes under (TelemetryEvent/CostRecord source_id).
